title: Reproducible analysis of generative AI use and student achievement in PISA 2025
description: Analysis accompanying the study Entre apoyo y automatización: uso de inteligencia artificial y rendimiento en PISA 2025. Reproducible country-specific weighted categorical associations with 10 plausible values and 80 BRR-Fay replicate weights. Primary CORE specification covers 32 OECD systems; full covariate specification is sensitivity. Includes methods, code, aggregate results and figures; excludes all individual microdata, weights and school identifiers. Cognitive substitution remains plausible but unproven.
